authority: BC-220 coordinator gate; implementation begins only after gate publication
question: Can an exact finite dual at Trump's side certify D > 11 and exclude the mass-eleven equality-density route?
first_family: Exact D4 orbit of Trump's 11-square packing, at most 88 placements before deduplication

inputs.geometry: Existing exact algebraic field at Trump's container side
inputs.deduplication: Deterministic exact placement identity with coalesced weights
inputs.containment: Exact containment of every square in the container
inputs.arrangement: Complete exact full-dimensional cells with an independently checked completeness receipt

semantics.depth: Sum of weights of interiors covering a full-dimensional arrangement cell
semantics.boundary: Finite edge and vertex union is a Lebesgue-null set; touching is allowed
semantics.D: Exact sum of all coalesced rational weights
semantics.soundness: Every atom is contained, every weight is nonnegative, arrangement completeness passes, and maximum full-dimensional depth is at most one
semantics.non_kill: D <= 11; D=11 does not establish a mass-eleven primal
semantics.forbidden_inference: No primal upper bound, strong duality, global packing optimum, or continuum coverage claim

required_controls: Exact unit-weight Trump family has D=11 and depth at most one
Uniform D4 orbit control with coalesced weights preserves D=11
Wall-crossing atom is rejected by exact containment
Unit-weight Trump interior perturbation with exact depth above one is rejected
Two distinct contained squares of weight1/2 each with positive-area overlap are accepted
Rational weight mutation producing an overweight full-dimensional cell is rejected
Negative, malformed and non-exact weights are rejected
Omitted arrangement cell or incomplete completeness receipt is rejected
Reordering preserves exact deduplication and D

ownership.implementation: closure manager, max reasoning for geometry and soundness
ownership.review: different context, max for mathematical judgment and xhigh for deterministic controls

required_output: Input Git revisions and repository-relative paths, exact placement count, rational D and containment verdict
Every full-dimensional arrangement cell, maximum rational depth and explicit null-set boundary
Measured wall and CPU costs, with missing measurements labeled unavailable
One terminal status: sound, unsound or time_limited
stop_rules: Freeze the implementation commit and pass controls before the pilot
Stop at each declared cap and retain incomplete work as time_limited
A failed soundness control prevents a sound verdict
No same-stem rerun, unregistered weight search or BC-244 work
BC-244's continuum-primal guard is not a prerequisite for this dual-only pilot
